title: Localized Gauss–Bonnet coupling around a hybrid scalar minimum
assumptions: Canonical scalar with V=V0 exp(−kappa lambda phi)+m_phi²phi²/2 and −f(phi)G; minimally coupled pressureless matter and radiation in flat FLRW.
Gaussian f has a source-declared center at the actual potential minimum; illustrative Fig.6 initial values violate this relation and cannot serve as a faithful benchmark.
Effective pressure reallocates GB exchange; intrinsic canonical w_phi, exchange-assigned w_phi^eff and total w_eff remain distinct.
predictions: Near a genuine minimum, local damped oscillations can occur when an approximately constant effective mass exceeds 3H/2; a localized curvature coupling changes the local restoring term.
The source proposes transient effective phantom crossings. Its action defines a useful conditional mechanism, while the displayed fixed-model/stability and data-viability claims remain unestablished.
Late modified-gravity oscillations do not supply the EDE pre-recombination depletion history or a unified early/late tracking scalar.
